parity/binary_trees_recursive/my: No equivalent frozen reference arm exists. Keep its absolute paired timing and correctness results; an agreed reference workload is needed before a relative gate can be established.
parity/calls/my: R found unsigned remainder already present and the floor-mod probe changed no reachable code. Inspect the dependent remainder chain and ten-iteration unrolling/spills; preserve the notail contract. A different language remainder rule is not an established explanation.
parity/intloop/my: The retained IR masks to 32 bits before a 64-bit unsigned remainder. Investigate narrower proven arithmetic and the unroll factor separately; the current native loop has ten dependent multiply sequences and nine spills. This is a candidate, not a measured speedup.
parity/records/my: The three fields are already in registers, the normalization is eliminated, and allocation/copy/check counters are zero. Investigate unrolling and the dependent remainder chain rather than enabling the regressing sret-sharing prototype.
parity/matmul/my-tuned: The bounds-off diagnostic takes about 0.810 times baseline cycles. The inner bk[j] child length loses its relation to the parameter across a tuple return while ci[j] is proved. Investigate interprocedural child-length facts; keep checks until proved.
parity/sort_quick/my: The bounds-off diagnostic takes about 0.943 times baseline cycles; removing counts gives about 0.998. Investigate a pivot/partition invariant that proves Hoare-scan accesses, then compare branch behavior. Counter reduction alone does not establish a wall-time gain.
parity/text_ops/my: The accepted lane still allocates 1,200,008 blocks, chiefly 800,013 in main and 399,995 in strings::repeat. Investigate direct destination construction for formatted fragments/numbers and repetition. Replacement already allocates one buffer but searches twice. Use the final profile before assigning time shares.
parity/scan_split/my: Lazy splitting and private offset storage already remove most allocation and piece copies. Profile the final remaining separator search and iterator checks before extending fusion; keep empty-piece, UTF-8, alias and trap behavior.
parity/sort_builtin/my: Stable radix sorting is already active for integer keys. If a gap remains, profile histogram/scatter, allocation and invariant-byte scans on the final executable; preserve stability and the allocation-before-mutation guarantee.
parity/nbody/my: The fixed-N/unrolled C ladder did not yield a 5% CPU-8 gain. Investigate distinct-index/disjoint-field proofs so the outer body velocity stays in SSA across pair updates, preserving floating-point order. A merged-versus-Zig pair-loop profile is still needed to distinguish reload/alias pressure from sqrt/div latency.
